# A struct named only as what a payload enum's member carries is declared:
# Go's `Result__Response` is a struct holding a `Response` and a `Failure`,
# and the shake neither counted a payload as a use nor promoted a library
# struct reached through one, so the Go targets said `undefined: Response`.
# The Result is held in a var nothing reads (held), handed to a function a
# lambda calls (handed), and returned by a function another reads (returned).

sngl test --platform=none held.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html held.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go held.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go held.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go held.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin held.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none handed.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html handed.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go handed.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go handed.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go handed.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin handed.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=none returned.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html returned.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go returned.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go returned.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go returned.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin returned.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- held.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component page ui.node {
    var last option[async.Result[http.Response]] = null
    ui.text(value="-")
}

func testA(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(true)
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
-- handed.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func answered(r async.Result[http.Response]) async.Result[string] {
    match var got = r {
        failed { return {failed=got} }
        ok { return {ok="x"} }
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    var on = ""
    var v option[string] = null
    async.query(on=on, fetch=func(k string, life async.Lifetime) => answered(http.get(url="http://127.0.0.1:47819/status/200", life=life)), :value=v)
    ui.button #go(text="go", @click { on = "a" })
}

func testB(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.go.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.v != null, 5000)
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
-- returned.sngl --
import async "sngl:async"
import http "sngl:http"
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

func ask(k string) async.Result[http.Response] {
    return http.get(url="http://127.0.0.1:47819/status/200")
}

func shown(k string, life async.Lifetime) async.Result[string] {
    match var r = ask(k) {
        failed { return {failed=r} }
        ok { return {ok="y"} }
    }
}

component page ui.node {
    var on = ""
    var v option[string] = null
    async.query(on=on, fetch=shown, :value=v)
    ui.button #go(text="go", @click { on = "a" })
}

func testE(t test.Test, c page) {
    c.go.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.v != null, 5000)
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
